title: Razor-sharp stone cuts at Kef Kalesi
summary: Matt tells of Razor-sharp stone cuts at Kef Kalesi, about ancient at Kef Kalesi, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: examples from ke excuse me from KF kesi that have um cuts that are so sharp you can still cut your finger on them

plain: A researcher identified only as Matt, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, talks about Kef Kalesi, an ancient stone site in Turkey. He says some of the cuts in the stone there are so sharp you can still cut your finger on them. He offers this as a sign that the ancient builders had more advanced tools or methods than people usually credit them with.
